description: keep git based? Partially open source? Like github? People come with their repos, we do the hosting people stay with us because it's convenient?

status.comment: Felix 2026-11-11: accepted "put the person into the idea" (fcb38df6), which moves the question of who may change what out of storage and into the data model. He wants to keep both the repository-based way and a hosted URL. Still undecided: what a hosted instance stores its graph in (a repository or a database), whether any part gets a proprietary license, and whether per-user worktrees (53a03e76) are still needed once ideas have owners.
